name: "Irish Whip" Rick O'Malley

tenures.source: Inducted into the RSPWF community's own Hall of Fame, 12 February 1997 class (/promotions/rspwf/archive/community-hall-of-fame-results-1997-02-12.html).

notes: The registry's other O'Malley rows (Anthony, Chris and Marcus) are all different first names with no document tying any of them to this character; a shared surname alone is never sufficient (no-auto-merge doctrine), so this stands as its own record.

name: Roker Showtime

tenures.source: Inducted into the RSPWF community's own Hall of Fame, 12 February 1997 class (/promotions/rspwf/archive/community-hall-of-fame-results-1997-02-12.html).

notes: Distinct from the registry's held "roker-showtime" (a Summit of E-Wrestling manager of 1995), per the coordinator's ruling of 2026-09-02: different federation, different role, different years, and no title, stable or partner receipt ties the two.

identity.note: The same billing ("Roker Showtime") is held by a Summit of E-Wrestling manager (roker-showtime, active 1995). Coordinator's ruling, 2026-09-02: different federation, different role (wrestler here, manager there), different years, and no title, stable or partner receipt ties the two — a shared name alone is never sufficient (no-auto-merge doctrine).
